title: 406 Red Cedar Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 406 Red Cedar Way is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Nestled on a quiet street in WaterColor’s sought-after Camp District, this elegant custom home offers a perfect balance of luxury, comfort, and location. With a 6-passenger electric cart, four adult bikes, and Beach Club access for up to 10 guests, 406 Red Cedar Way is an exceptional retreat for families and friends seeking a peaceful coastal escape.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 10 Passes Included 6-Passenger Electric Cart Included in Rental 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Parking for 2 Vehicles Propane Grill Large Covered Deck and Garden Dining Area Located in the Heart of WaterColor’s Camp District 4-Minute Walk to Camp WaterColor Pools 6-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access 7-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Welcome to 406 Red Cedar Way, a beautifully crafted WaterColor home designed for connection and comfort. Overlooking a lush park and surrounded by serene natural scenery, this home provides a perfect setting for relaxation and family gatherings. The main living area features an open-concept design, combining the kitchen, dining, and living spaces into one bright and inviting area. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with high-end stainless-steel appliances, a spacious island, and bar seating for casual dining. The adjoining living room offers comfortable furnishings and a cozy gas fireplace, an ideal space to unwind after a day at the beach. Also on the first floor are two guest bedrooms and a built-in bunk area. The first guest bedroom features a queen bed and access to a shared bathroom with a tub/shower combination, while the second offers a king bed and private en-suite bath with a walk-in shower. The hallway bunk area includes a twin-over-twin setup, providing fun and functional sleeping space for children. Each of these rooms opens onto a generous screened-in porch that overlooks the tranquil nature preserve, offering an ideal place to relax in privacy. Upstairs, the primary suite serves as a serene retreat with vaulted ceilings, exposed cedar beams, and a king bed complemented by a twin trundle for flexible sleeping arrangements. The en-suite bathroom includes a spacious walk-in shower and elegant finishes, completing this relaxing second-level escape. Outside, guests can enjoy dining al fresco in the garden area, grilling with family, or exploring the neighborhood on one of the provided adult bikes. With its ideal proximity to Camp WaterColor, Wood Fern Park, and the Beach Club, this home delivers the perfect combination of style, comfort, and location for your next 30A getaway.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Hallway Bunk Area: Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Half Bathroom Second Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2) and One Twin Trundle Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Life in WaterColor Located in the heart of the Camp District, 406 Red Cedar Way places guests within walking distance of Camp WaterColor’s pools and playgrounds, Wood Fern Park, and scenic nature trails. Enjoy easy access to Seaside and the Beach Club by bike or electric cart. With its inviting layout, refined finishes, and family-friendly features, this home captures the essence of the WaterColor lifestyle.
